name: VC Trader AI Revise Report
description: Publishes a corrected report superseding an earlier one. Calls the propfirm_manager BFF at POST /api/v1/workspaces/{ws}/reports/{report_id}/revise as the workspace owner (PFM_AGENT_TOKEN, ADR 0078). DIRECT_CONTROL per core/openclaw/allowlist.py. Nothing is edited in place: the original is preserved exactly as delivered, so an already-sent message still shows what the reader was told.
